v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cantáte * Dómino et benedícite nómini eius.
text.en: Sing ye * to the Lord and bless his name.
The salvation of my countenance * and my God.

text.la: Illúmina, Dómine, * vultum tuum super nos.
text.en: May the Lord shine the light * of his countenance upon us.

text.la: Exaltáte * Regem sæculórum in opéribus vestris.
text.en: Give ye glory to him * in your works.

text.la: Laudáte * nomen Dómini, qui statis in domo Dómini.
text.en: Praise * the name of the Lord, ye who stand in the house of the Lord.

text.la: Surge, illumináre Ierúsalem, quia venit lumen tuum, et glória Dómini super te orta est.
text.en: Arise, be enlightened, O Jerusalem: for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

text.la: Vénient ad te, * qui detrahébant tibi, et adorábunt vestígia pedum tuórum.
text.en: They that despised thee * shall come unto thee, and shall bow themselves down at the Soles of thy Feet.

text.la: Vota, quǽsumus, Dómine, supplicántis pópuli cælésti pietáte proséquere: ut et quæ agénda sunt, vídeant, et ad implénda quæ víderint, convaléscant.
text.en: Attend, O Lord, we beseech thee, of thy heavenly mercy, to the desires of thy suppliant people; and grant that they may both perceive what they ought to do, and may have strength to fulfill the same.

text.la: Qui odit ánimam suam in hoc mundo, in vitam ætérnam custódit eam.
text.en: He that hateth his life in this world, shall keep it unto life eternal.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum Hygínum Mártyrem tuum atque Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
text.en: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed Hyginus thy Martyr and Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.
